solution_summary: Gmarket built its Databricks implementation around Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Apache Spark. Gmarket operates the largest e-commerce platform in the domestic market, supporting online transactions in various categories in domestic and international consumer markets. As an open market powerhouse in the e-commerce field, it focuses on building connections between sellers and buyers, and provides the best business environment for sellers and differentiated customer experiences for buyers, by utilizing data-base. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment.
